title: acosta brachtii
intro: Acosta brachtii, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy, is a plant species in the Papaveraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Acosta brachtii include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief and wound healing. Therapeutically, Acosta brachtii is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin issues, due to its antipyretic, expectorant, and antiseptic properties.
